title: Citizen-developer sandbox app manifest (app.yaml)
description: The only file a citizen developer's Cowork skill must emit. Everything the platform needs to build, isolate, and expire the app. No secrets, no infrastructure.

name.description: DNS-safe app name. Becomes the namespace suffix and the URL slug.

sponsor.description: Business reviewer who can claim the app and extend its TTL.

purpose.description: One paragraph: what the app does and who reviews it.

stack.description: Pilot supports two stacks. The gate rejects anything else with a plain-language message.

entrypoint.description: python-web only. ASGI app path, e.g. 'app.main:app'. Ignored for static.

dataClassification.description: Pilot accepts only these. 'confidential' or 'restricted' is rejected: the sandbox never holds real regulated data.

database.description: Ephemeral Postgres in the same namespace, seeded from seed.sql if present. Deleted with the namespace.

egress.description: Internal FQDNs the app must reach. Each one must be on the platform allowlist AND is reviewed by a human in the PR. Empty means DNS-only.
